findings.description: The algorithm never defines the fail-closed outcome when the visible book cannot produce a full-size WAP on the correct side, or when `BestPrice` is unusable. That leaves oversized or empty-book cases open to divergent dispatch behavior.

evidence.quote: 2. Compute the Weighted Avg Price (WAP) for `OrderQty`.

findings.proposed_fix: Add a deterministic no-dispatch rule for empty/insufficient-depth/nonpositive-best-price books and cover it with an acceptance test.

findings.description: Step 5 requires computed WAP and slippage on every rejection, but Step 0 rejects missing/unparseable/stale L2 before any book walk. The contract does not define the rejection log payload for those pre-check exits.

evidence.quote: 5. If rejected, log `LiquidityGateReject` with computed WAP \+ slippage.

findings.proposed_fix: Limit WAP/slippage logging to slippage-based rejects or define a separate deterministic log payload for stale/missing-L2 exits.

findings.description: The fixture makes `TradingMode::ReduceOnly` a normative consequence of the no-fallback path, but no acceptance test in this file asserts the mode resolver result or OPEN blocking after the degrade transition.
findings.proposed_fix: Add an acceptance test that verifies `EmergencyCloseNoPrice` drives `TradingMode::ReduceOnly` and keeps OPEN intents blocked.
